void-indigo.$description: Void Indigo — Page canvas — the cosmic-dark background that radiates the aurora gradient. All marketing copy and product panels float on this surface

deep-space.$description: Deep Space — Outer page background where the aurora gradient fades to black, framing the central glow

product-white.$description: Product White — Product panel surfaces, input fields, card fills inside the embedded product screenshots, and the top navigation bar

pure-ink.$description: Pure Ink — Primary text color inside product panels and on white surfaces — near-black, slightly softer than #000

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary text, icon strokes on dark canvas, and dark-mode body copy

steel.$description: Steel — Muted helper text, secondary nav labels, and inactive tab text

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Tertiary text and body copy on white surfaces

hairline.$description: Hairline — Borders, dividers, table separators, and subtle structural lines — the dominant border color across all components

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Supporting palette color for small decorative accents when the core palette needs contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

plasma-violet.$description: Plasma Violet — Supporting palette color for small decorative accents when the core palette needs contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

nebula-blue.$description: Nebula Blue — Secondary brand fill — vivid blue-violet used for solid accent surfaces and card backgrounds in feature blocks

cosmic-purple.$description: Cosmic Purple — Deep purple background fill for video thumbnail cards and feature panels, anchoring darker sections of the page

twilight-iris.$description: Twilight Iris — Muted violet used for subtle borders and outlines on the dark canvas — a low-contrast structural line

blush-mist.$description: Blush Mist — Pastel rose-tinted surface for soft accent cards and pill buttons — the warmest of the pastel constellation

lavender-whisper.$description: Lavender Whisper — Pastel lavender surface for accent cards and ghost buttons — the signature pastel that bridges the aurora's pink and purple ends

sunbeam.$description: Sunbeam — Pastel cream-yellow surface for warm accent cards and highlight buttons

polar-sky.$description: Polar Sky — Pastel blue-white surface for cool accent cards and secondary CTA buttons

mint-glow.$description: Mint Glow — Pastel mint surface for accent cards and quiet informational buttons

focus-beam.$description: Focus Beam — Blue supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

inter.$description: Single-family system: Inter carries everything from 10px eyebrow labels to 64px display headlines. The aggressive negative tracking at display sizes (-3.2px at 64px) makes headlines feel dense and architectural rather than airy, which suits the cosmic-dark page. Positive 0.5px tracking only appears on 10px uppercase eyebrows, creating a tight micro-label style. Weight 500 is the default for UI; 600 for button labels; 700 sparingly for hero emphasis.
